subject: Supplier portal: intermittent 302 redirect loop blocking invite acceptance

Subject: Cannot accept supplier invite — portal stuck in 302 redirects

Hi Naomi,

We received the Coupa invite this morning but when our AP user (accounts@stalwartlogistics.com) clicks the link the browser keeps getting bounced between the public gateway and the portal with a repeating 302. The page never reaches the acceptance form — it just flashes the login page and then redirects away. We tried Chrome and Firefox; same behavior.

I captured a short HTTP trace and a screenshot attached (redirect_trace.txt, screenshot-portal-302.png). Our IT tried clearing cookies and testing on a different network; still getting the loop.

Can you advise next steps? We need this vendor account active to receive POs this week. If helpful, we can hop on a quick call with your team and our infrastructure folks.

Thanks,
Jorge Ortega
Head of Procurement — Stalwart Logistics
jorge.ortega@stalwartlogistics.com

Hi Jorge —

Thanks for the trace and screenshot. Sorry you're blocked — I can see why that prevents acceptance. Quick notes and asks so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm whether the invite link has a tenant query param (tenant=stalwart) or an ampersand-style relaystate? That helps narrow which redirect handler is firing.
- Can you paste the exact invite URL (remove any MFA tokens) or DM it to me if you prefer?
- For an immediate workaround: if your team opens the invite in an incognito window (no extensions), does the loop still happen? I know you tried clearing cookies but incognito helps isolate cookie boundaries.

I'm looping in Ben (partner sales) and Marissa (onboarding ops). Ben — we saw a similar pattern last quarter where a TLS offload in front of the portal stripped X-Forwarded headers and Coupa's session router responded with repeated 302s. Would you take a look and advise whether we should open an expedited ticket with Coupa or push a slightly modified invite (different domain) to the customer?

I'll stand by for the invite URL/logs and can schedule a 20-minute bridge if we need to bring in infra.

Best,
Naomi
Enterprise Customer Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jorge Ortega <jorge.ortega@stalwartlogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cannot accept supplier invite — portal stuck in 302 redirects

Jorge / Naomi —

Thanks for the evidence. Quick troubleshooting checklist from our side:

- Common root cause: load balancer/TLS termination dropping or rewriting cookie attributes (SameSite, Secure) so the portal session can't establish. Coupa will emit a 302 back to the gateway when session cookie isn't present.
- Can your IT confirm if there's an inline TLS terminator (F5/NGINX) that rewrites headers? If so, ask them to preserve X-Forwarded-Proto and not strip Set-Cookie attributes.
- Another test: if you use curl with -L (to follow redirects) and verbose output, do you see a Set-Cookie header being returned and then a subsequent response that omits it? That would indicate the cookie was stripped mid-path.

If you prefer, we can open a support case with Coupa and include the exact redirect_trace file. Marissa — do we have a hot path for Coupa issues that need slightly faster triage during onboarding windows? If yes, please advise contact and I'll prepare the case with logs.

— Ben
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: IT Support <it-support@stalwartlogistics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 13:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cannot accept supplier invite — portal stuck in 302 redirects

Hi Ben / Naomi,

We ran the curl test you suggested. The attached coupa_response_log.txt shows the sequence: initial 302 includes Set-Cookie: coupa_session=abc123; SameSite=None; Secure, then the subsequent request (back to the gateway) does not include Cookie header — looks like our edge proxy is terminating TLS and not forwarding the set-cookie correctly when redirecting between the public gateway and internal portal.

We also tried an incognito window as Naomi suggested; that did not help.

Next steps from our side: we've opened an internal ticket with our infra team to adjust the gateway behavior; however, they expect this will take 4–6 hours to test. If Redwood can reissue an invite that uses the secondary domain (portal-us.redwoodinference.com) or provide a manual acceptance flow, that would let us complete onboarding before the end-of-day PO cutover.

Regards,
Stalwart IT
IT Support — Stalwart Logistics

2) Ben will prepare a short troubleshooting note for Stalwart IT that they can pass to their infra team (including the cookie header evidence and curl commands).
3) Naomi will provide a manual vendor activation flow if the portal remains blocked after their infra changes; that will let Stalwart start receiving POs.

Marissa — please paste the Coupa support contact and case number here once opened. Jorge — we'll aim to have either the invite domain swap or manual activation completed within the 4–6 hour window you mentioned; if that slips, we'll arrange a bridge immediately.

Apologies for the friction today — we know the delivery timeline is tight.

Best,
